summary: Phases 16-20 of the twenty-seven-phase plan landed sorry-free and gate-green, dissolving the obstruction Phase 5 had recorded at GHR Lemma 10.2.3's Cases 6, 7 and 8: that obstruction described a direct semantic re-anchoring route the source does not use. Reading GHR vol. 1 Chapter 10 section 10.2's printed text directly gave the reduction order with every edge source-quoted, and all eight cases of Lemma 10.2.3 are now proved, together with Lemma 10.2.4's equivalence and its separatedness. Two printed-text defects are pinned with compiled counterexamples: GHR's Case 5 formula is false over the integers under every bracketing, and its claim that Case 8's third disjunct is redundant is false. The headline deliverable separationOver_ztime is still NOT discharged and no tr row changed.
blockers: Phase 21 is BLOCKED on a NEW obstruction, different from the one Phase 5 recorded. uTypeCount -- the plan's measure, the number of distinct maximal untl subformulas -- cannot carry GHR 10.2.6's induction over the eliminations as landed, because Phase 20's sepSnce can increase it. Cause: Eliminations.lean's landed case2Rhs is built as (... ) or case1Rhs a q (A.neg.and B.neg) A.neg together with allFuture A.neg, so it carries the untl types untl A.neg (A.neg.and B.neg) and untl top A.neg.neg beside untl B A; GHR's printed Case 2 carries neither, because its third step folds G-not-A or U(not-A and not-B, not-A) back into not-U(A,B) by Lemma 10.2.2 in reverse, which the landed proof omits. case3Rhs consumes case2Rhs, and case6Rhs/case7Rhs/case8Rhs consume case3Rhs/case8Rhs, so three of sepSnce's four constituents inherit it. Two repair routes, both recorded in the plan's Phase 21 blocker entry: (1) add a second Case 2 lemma at GHR's printed three-disjunct right-hand side and re-derive Cases 3, 6, 7, 8 through it -- additive, no signature change, and uTypeCount then works as specified; (2) change the measure to count untl occurrences under a snce rather than distinct untl types -- leaves the landed layer untouched but redesigns the measures of Phases 21, 22 and 23. Choosing between them is a planning decision, not an implementation one.

Phases 22-27 are NOT STARTED, gated behind Phase 21. The plan's own standing warning is unchanged: Phase 23's junction-depth strict decrease is asserted without proof in the source and is the plan's primary stall candidate; it has still never been reached.

artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: all eight GHR 10.2.3 cases and 10.2.4 landed, the two printed-text defects pinned, and the new Phase 21 obstruction located with two repair routes.
Phase 16's gate record: the source-quoted reduction DAG, five compiled probe models, the refutation of the two-disjunct Case 5 repair, and the Case 8 non-redundancy model.
